records.title: Add a business
records.description: Provide the public business name, category, address, official website and public business contacts. Describe the services and link evidence for factual claims. Only submit images you can license for this use and include attribution. A request enters review; it does not publish a listing or make the business a YouNew partner. No approval time, customers or promotion results are promised.

records.title: Claim or correct a business
records.description: Identify the existing listing and explain your authority to represent the organization. Supply the official website, applicable registration details and evidence for the requested change. Keep private contact information separate from public business contacts. Review checks representation, sources and duplicates before a decision. Corrections can be requested with the listing ID, changed field, proposed value and supporting URL. Ownership is not confirmed by submitting a form.
